summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 15/16 pytest cases pass (1 known third-party Stripe-poll failure). Frontend mobile UI (390x844): all new features verified end-to-end — new home title, 5 chips with auto-submit, quota pill that decrements, 4th-match -> /paywall?reason=limit redirect, paywall pricing/buttons, Start 7-day free trial -> 'Free trial active', Settings subscription card transitions Free->Trial correctly, NIV/KJV toggle persists.

minor.issue: When polling a freshly-created cs_test_... session, Stripe returns 'No such checkout.session' which the emergentintegrations library wraps in CheckoutError -> uncaught -> 500. Endpoint should catch CheckoutError and return 4xx (e.g., 502/424) or a graceful payload instead of leaking 500. Reproduce: POST /api/subscription/checkout {origin_url}, then immediately GET /api/subscription/status/{session_id}. Root cause: emergentintegrations creates the session via integrations.emergentagent.com proxy but get_checkout_status() queries Stripe directly with sk_test_emergent which cannot find the session in that account.

issues: Pre-existing console deprecation warnings still present (shadow* style, TouchableWithoutFeedback in app/(tabs)/index.tsx, props.pointerEvents, expo-av, expo-notifications web push). Non-blocking.

action_items: Wrap the get_checkout_status call in /api/subscription/status/{session_id} with try/except for emergentintegrations CheckoutError and return 200 with payment_status='unknown' or a 502, so the frontend success page can poll without a 500.
(Optional) Replace TouchableWithoutFeedback in app/(tabs)/index.tsx with Pressable to silence RN web warning.
(Optional) Migrate VersePlayer from expo-av to expo-audio before SDK 54.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~695 lines and starting to feel large; consider splitting routers (auth, verses, subscription, tts) into modules.
is_user_premium() correctly checks both status and current_period_end; trial and active branches share the same gate.
Quota check correctly placed BEFORE the LLM call — no wasted LLM tokens on blocked requests.
_grant_premium_for_user extends from max(now, current_period_end) which is the right behavior for stacking renewals.
Webhook handler depends on emergentintegrations parsing the body; signature mismatches return 400 as expected.
PATCH /api/settings/translation uses Pydantic Literal['NIV','KJV'] giving automatic 422 on invalid values — good.
Frontend api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via process.env (already verified iteration 1).
Free verses counter and gating are atomic via $inc; no race condition in single-user scenarios.

rca_of_issue: GET /api/subscription/status/{session_id} -> 500. RCA: line 611 server.py calls stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status(session_id) without try/except. For freshly created emergent-proxy sessions Stripe returns 'No such checkout.session' which emergentintegrations re-raises as CheckoutError, bubbling to FastAPI as 500. Mitigation: wrap call in try/except CheckoutError and return {'payment_status':'unknown', 'error':str(e)} or HTTPException(status_code=502).
